title: AWSSDK.S3
description: Amazon S3 object storage client for uploading, downloading, and managing S3 buckets and objects.

data.text: `AWSSDK.S3` is the official AWS SDK for S3 in .NET. It supports uploading, downloading, listing, and deleting objects, as well as generating pre-signed URLs and managing bucket policies.
Create an `AmazonS3Client` using credentials and a region, then call methods like `PutObjectAsync` and `GetObjectAsync`.

terms.definition: The main client for interacting with S3 buckets and objects.
Uploads a file or stream to an S3 bucket.

data.title: Warning
data.text: Never embed secret keys in client-side code. Use IAM roles or environment variables instead.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Use `AmazonS3Client` to connect to S3 with credentials.
Prefer IAM roles over hardcoded keys in production.
Pre-signed URLs are the safest way to share private objects.
data.takeaway: AWSSDK.S3 makes it straightforward to work with Amazon S3 in .NET applications.
